notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The previous render is the dist-gated recreation. The revised one opens the clip's bore from r 15.5 to 15.65 (slip, on Diff Body B's printed shell) and the Ø3.0 beam bores to Ø3.1 (press, on the T-1 body); the counterbores, the nail holes and everything else keep their size. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
